$comment: Runtime configuration. Safety defaults: audit-only, no writes, one lead.

urls.$comment: Confirm in Phase 1 by copying the real URLs from the address bar.

marketStatus.$comment: REI 'Market Status' value that maps to each pipeline stage. Evaluating is confirmed ('Follow up'). The others are OPEN ITEMS (SOP v2 §8) — leave null and the engine HOLDS + flags those leads instead of guessing a value.

address.$comment_tidy: false = flag-only (recommended for unattended runs): capture ZIPs from notes, flag dupes/malformed, but do not rewrite street text. true = also tidy obvious suffix/casing.
